keyB.notes: p149 starts a new day page (أعوذ + basmala + Quran), not a continuation; أعوذ line written as a bold paragraph, as in my earlier batches for the matching pages. Comma followed directly by the next word without a space (e.g. تَوَلَّيْتُ،فَلَا) is normalized to comma + space. Item numbers printed «٦٩/ ٧٠-», «٧١/ ٧٢-», «٧٣/ ٧٤-» (with a space after the slash) are written without the space: ٦٩/٧٠-. Several آلِه are printed with only one kasra (under the ل); written آلِه. Final ت in ظَهَرَتْ، رُزِقَتْ، هُدِيَتْ (p150) carries a sukun, i.e. feminine verbs. On p151 the closing «يَا قَادِرُ عَلَى» and on p150 the closing names are printed black (not red). p152 continues p151 mid-sentence (marker +).
